name: Bulk Custom Email Sender from Spreadsheet (Secured)

nodes.name: Read Spreadsheet
nodes.notes: Configure: Set your Google Sheet document ID and sheet name. Expected columns: email, first_name, last_name, company, subject, body_template, custom_field_1, custom_field_2

nodes.name: Sanitize and Validate Input
nodes.notes: SECURITY GATE: Validates email format (RFC 5322), strips header injection chars (CRLF/null), HTML-encodes text fields to prevent XSS, deduplicates recipients, caps at 500 max, truncates oversized fields. Addresses OWASP A05:2025 Injection.

nodes.name: Loop Over Items
nodes.notes: Processes one email per iteration. Output 0 = 'done' (all processed). Output 1 = 'loop' (next batch item).

nodes.name: Compose Personalized Email
nodes.notes: Performs placeholder substitution on pre-sanitized data. No raw user input enters HTML structure at this stage.

nodes.name: Send Email (Gmail)
nodes.notes: Uses Gmail OAuth2. On failure, routes to error output (output index 1) so the loop continues.

nodes.name: Send Email (SMTP)
nodes.notes: SMTP alternative. Enable this and disable Gmail node to use. On failure, routes to error output.

nodes.name: Throttle Delay
nodes.notes: 5-second delay between sends. Conservative default to avoid rate limits and spam flags.

nodes.name: Log Success
nodes.notes: Logs only status, recipient address, and timestamp — no email body or subject to avoid sensitive data leakage in logs.

nodes.name: Log Failure
nodes.notes: Captures failure with truncated error message. No sensitive data in logs.

nodes.name: Write Log to Sheet
nodes.notes: Appends send result (status + recipient + timestamp only) to 'Send Log' tab. No email content stored.

string.name: summary
string.value: ={{ 'Batch complete. Total processed: ' + $('Sanitize and Validate Input').all().length }}

nodes.name: Batch Complete Summary
nodes.notes: Runs only after ALL items have been processed (connected to SplitInBatches done output).
